correctness.rationale: Use all 65536 masks on sixteen row-major grid vertices; alpha(S)=max(alpha(S\{v}),1+alpha(S\N[v])) gives exact induced independence number and excludes precisely those containing any of the 405 independent 4-sets. Independent re-enumeration gives the complete augmented f vector (1,16,120,560,1415,1788,912), sum 4812. The stated deterministic greedy vertex-toggle matching (v=0,...,15) makes 2364 matched pairs; remaining exactly 84 six-vertex faces. On the FULL augmented Hasse diagram, orient all matched incidences up and all other incidences down and exhaustively topologically sort all 4812 nodes and 22008 directed edges, confirming no directed cycle. Deleting the matched empty-simplex pair leaves an ordinary matching with one critical vertex and eighty-four critical 5-faces, so Forman's theorem gives a CW realization with one 0-cell and 84 5-cells; all attaching maps to a point are constant and the result is wedge 84 S5. Independent regeneration reproduced the face vector, matches, critical faces, Hasse edge count and complete sort; the additional mod2 verifier only corroborates integral homotopy. Precisely one 4x4,k=4 instance; not a proof of all-k rectangular-grid conjectures.
